title: collomia debilis f. howardii
intro: Collomia debilis f. howardii, commonly known as Howard's collomia, is a plant species within the phlox family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Howard's collomia include its use as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs, and its potential as an anti-inflammatory agent to reduce swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
